The cloze explain is about patrician families holding power in Rome's early republic.  The four shared words (file, people, held, early) are ordinary vocabulary:  the explain says nothing about beliefs, the Office, or what it files, so it cannot hand over the span.

It never says, or implies, that A carries YES on all three tests, which is what this item asks.  A stem that names a label is the false-positive case the gate's own header describes.
